translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Pak ne Jehova Nyasaye!
Ogwedh ngʼama oluoro Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo marito chikene gi mor.
Nyithinde nobed joma roteke e piny;
ee, koth joma ngimagi oriere tir ibiro gwedhi.
Pith gi mwandu yudore e ode,
kendo timne makare osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
Ngʼama ngimane oriere ler rienyne kata gotieno, ngʼat mangʼwon,
ma kecho ji kendo makare.
Ngʼama ngʼwon ma holo ji gige gi chuny maler biro neno ber
ngʼat matiyo tijene gi adiera.
Adier, onge gima nyalo yienge,
ngʼat makare ibiro par nyaka chiengʼ.
Ok oluoro weche makelo kuyo
nikech chunye otegno kendo ogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
Chunye ok chandre kendo oonge gi luoro moro amora;
ongʼeyo ni obiro neno ka olo wasike ka en to olocho.
Gisepogo gigegi ne joma odhier, bergi osiko nyaka chiengʼ;
duongʼne gi luor ma ji oluorego,
biro siko nyaka chiengʼ.
Ngʼama timbene richo biro nene mi iye wangʼ,
obiro mwodo lekene kendo obiro chiyore morum;
gik ma ngʼama timbene richo gombo ni otimrene ok bi timorene ngangʼ.
